blocks.text: Python programming ki dunya mein khush aamdeed! Python ek mashhoor aur versatile (har kaam mein kaam aane wali) language hai. Yeh apni simplicity (saadgi) aur readability (parhne mein aasani) ki wajah se naye seekhne walon aur professionals dono ke liye behtareen hai. Is chapter mein hum basics (shuru ki baaton) se shuru karenge: apna development environment tayyar karna aur programming ke basic concepts seekhna. Phir hum advanced (aage ke) topics parhenge, jaise modular programming, file handling, debugging aur data structures. Chapter ke aakhir tak aap Python achhi tarah samajh jayenge aur apne programs aur Command Line Interface (CLI) applications khud likh, test aur debug kar sakenge.

Python ek bohat istemal hone wali high-level programming language hai jo apni saadgi aur readability ke liye mashhoor hai. Yeh kai fields (shobon) mein kaam aati hai, jaise web development, data analysis aur artificial intelligence. Is ka syntax (likhne ke qawaid) seedha aur banawat saaf hai, is liye naye seekhne wale mushkil rules (qawaid) mein uljhne ki bajaye programming ke concepts par dhyan de sakte hain. Chhota sa script likhna ho ya bara software, Python jaldi aur aasani se kaam shuru karwa deti hai.

items: Python: mashhoor high-level language, saada aur parhne mein aasan.
Web development, data analysis aur AI mein istemal hoti hai.
Chapter basics se modules, OOP, files, testing aur CLI applications tak jata hai.
